notes: Fix: the estimated Strength score read whatever your heaviest lift happened to be against the BENCH PRESS standards. A big leg press, judged as a bench press, could hand you a Very good rating on pressing you have never done. Every lift is now scored against its own published table
Fix: a bodyweight check-in recording only body fat wiped out your known weight, so Strength silently fell back to a guessed 80 kg and Vitality lost its BMI reading
Fix: logging one exercise on two cards in the same session counted as two separate sessions, so the app could compare a session against itself and report progress that did not happen
Fix: cardio intervals counted as strength working sets, inflating your volume tolerance with work you did not do with weights
